headline: Recurring revenue and free cash flow both hit records
summary_short: Total revenue rose 8.2% y/y to $645.1M, with SaaS revenue accelerating 21.7% to $230.6M; free cash flow hit a Q2 record of $118.5M (+34.7% y/y). GAAP diluted EPS rose 15.6% y/y to $2.23, aided by a $25.0M one-time gain on remeasurement of an equity investment.
summary_long: Recurring revenue (86.7% of total) grew 8.2% y/y to $559.5M, powered by SaaS revenue up 21.7% to $230.6M — the 22nd straight quarter of 20%+ SaaS growth — while GAAP operating income was roughly flat y/y ($95.1M) as G&A and R&D both grew faster than revenue. Net income of $93.5M (+10.5% y/y) included a $25.0M gain on remeasurement of an equity investment, excluded from the $129.0M non-GAAP figure. The company deployed $213M on the For The Record acquisition and $505M on buybacks, funded partly by a new $1.4B convertible note; cash stayed above $1B. FY2026 guidance: revenue $2.535B-$2.575B, non-GAAP diluted EPS $12.95-$13.20, FCF margin 26-28%.

drivers.explanation: CEO Lynn Moore attributed the quarter to strong execution across financial and operational measures, citing SaaS acceleration, healthy public-sector modernization demand, and record second-quarter free cash flow.
SaaS revenue grew 21.7% to $230.6M on sustained public-sector modernization demand, which the release says drove record SaaS and total bookings; transaction revenue grew a slower 3.5%.

Not explained in the release beyond the underlying expense-line detail; G&A rose 22.4% y/y and R&D rose 23.6% y/y, both faster than the 8.2% revenue growth, which arithmetically explains the flat GAAP operating income.

GAAP net income growth (10.5% y/y) outpaced GAAP operating income growth mainly because of a $25.0M non-recurring gain on remeasurement of an equity investment, which the release explicitly excludes from its non-GAAP net income of $129.0M (+0.9% y/y).

Cash rose y/y mainly from May's $1.4B convertible-note offering (net proceeds ~$1.2B after capped calls), partly offset by $213M spent on the For The Record acquisition and $505M of share buybacks this quarter.
The release does not narrate the equity decline directly; it is arithmetically consistent with $755M of YTD treasury-share purchases (per the cash-flow statement) exceeding YTD net income of $174.7M.
